messages.game.28455f89a23a2dc3: ...We're here. This is the entrance to Kansai.
messages.game.a8a5a3f611b0f738: ...Hey, did you notice? First Tokyo. Then Kanto. And now, Kansai.
messages.game.2a4c54965f3aa463: It's spreading in order. ...And it seems like a lot of compound-word KanjiMon are starting to appear.
messages.game.c0fef213cfb872b0: For a thousand years, everyone has climbed these stone steps.
messages.game.e65357b753157497: ...If you can read the kanji, you can even learn what people prayed for.
messages.game.a2d667dd02f02214: Come on, let's go. Kansai is big.
messages.game.bddf07d63faeb114: The trees rustled. ...Did someone just pass by?
messages.game.1110e519e380ef38: All the kanji on the scroll are facing backward. ...No one can read them.
messages.game.1534c02cfa98fc06: 反 (reverse) means to flip something over. 転 (turn) means to roll it and change its direction.
messages.game.f0e9cc654020da23: When we reflected it in the water... look, we could read it!
messages.game.53eb00ff266f6e3f: The ninja grandpa said this: 'Well spotted. 反 (reverse) and 転 (turn) are the ninja's greatest technique.'
messages.game.c11b0ec70bb46d86: This is Lake Biwa in Shiga. It's the largest lake in Japan.
messages.game.957f8a81778ea00e: The sign about where swimming is allowed can't be read, so everyone is waiting on the shore.
messages.game.69485ba1f971175e: There are 深 (deep) places and shallow places. Near the 岸 (shore), it's fine to 泳 (swim).
messages.game.cd30cddf78f04983: The children all leaped into the water at once!
messages.game.f5bc280eac4cfaeb: ...Hey. Who was that big person? They looked this way and left.
messages.game.2c4cd159db3ff824: Stone foundations are lined up straight. ...So there was a big building here.
messages.game.372f73dab3266b1a: The year on the old sign can't be read, so no one knows when it's from.
messages.game.8c1716e05e22a300: For 昔 (long ago), imagine days piled upon days. 号 (name or number) is a mark used to identify something.
messages.game.021c9035c2645f57: When I stood at the central 央 (center), I learned this spot was the middle of the capital.
messages.game.b3db26ad9c5644b8: The grandpa said this: 'Kanji from a thousand years ago can still be read today. ...That's an amazing thing.'
messages.game.e629fa10269f4a4c: The soles of my feet are warm. ...I wonder if hot water is flowing below.
messages.game.1af613b7243e866a: The garden route guide can't be read, so everyone is wandering in circles.
messages.game.b0fef0a3f3c22850: Go up the 坂 (slope), cross the 橋 (bridge). That's the route through this 庭 (garden).
messages.game.9c57dd1e9d57609d: ...When you know the way, the scenery looks even better, doesn't it.
messages.game.db4e73953a0633f0: Tap, tap, tap. ...The sound of hands working comes from all around.
messages.game.fd635c2c85ff471e: The kanji in the order book is rampaging, and they almost made the wrong brush.
messages.game.46e1778611fd906b: The thickness of the 筆 (brush) is written on the 帳 (ledger) page. 具 (tool/kit) means 道具 (tools).
messages.game.457bf90facd237e9: The artisan took the correct brush in hand.
messages.game.97e96371bf0d3d1f: They said this: 'If you can't read the kanji, your hands stop. ...You saved me.'
messages.game.7c67fa38e2ac922a: The voices are amazing. 'Maido!' 'Ookini!' ...Everyone's so full of energy.
messages.game.59ebe94a39cc6f8e: The 区 (section/district) of the delivery addresses can't be read, so the packages have stopped.
messages.game.d83d5016fd66a75c: The person who 送 (sends) and the person who 受 (receives). 区 (ward) is how the town is divided up.
messages.game.3e1708cb9b814016: The packages all started moving at once!
messages.game.ec86361102f38d1a: The courier said this: 'Where the packages stopped, that person had already come by.'
messages.game.02e2428460865237: Even looking up, I can't see the top. ...Each stone is bigger than our house.
messages.game.ab1bedb2d8509610: The old records can't be read, so no one knows which generation the lord was.
messages.game.8f14dd6b2eedf477: The people who 守 (defended) this castle. 主 (master) is the lord. 代 (generation) is what gets passed down.
messages.game.1302a931653ca6bf: ...Up to the third generation, the names connected properly.
messages.game.8f50b40446dfa8a5: The guide said this: 'If we couldn't read it, we'd never have known whose castle it was.'
messages.game.1e0385320df9de8d: Fee-hyara, fee-hyara. ...The crowd keeps growing and growing.
messages.game.69719fa74d6755c8: There's a lost child. They can't read the call-out notice board.
messages.game.60acad9b65e68def: Where people 「集」gather. Toward the sound of the 「笛」flute.
messages.game.6553556b527968cc: When they held up a paper that said 「助」help... their mother came running!
messages.game.863236f6a1568dac: ...Ah. Beyond the crowd. That tall back, head and shoulders above everyone, again.
messages.game.775f149ac87ba343: It's so dazzling you squint. ...Its shape is like a bird spreading its wings.
messages.game.f1e94ab9ab323b5e: They can't read the guide saying how many 「階」floors you can climb.
messages.game.8398a54e24cd279d: 階 means a floor or level. 表 means the front or surface. 面 is a face or surface, like the face of a wall.
messages.game.657e090e4215a410: They made it up to the sixth floor. From the very top, they could see the whole town!
messages.game.e4bc55d31fd3ab59: ...The white walls are dazzling, aren't they?
messages.game.5a3fa771e9ac1a9f: You can hear all kinds of languages. ...It's like this place isn't Japan.
messages.game.46b490f0f3794418: A person from a distant land is stuck because they can't read Japanese characters.
messages.game.d7e2a2e6e798a616: Some 漢字 (kanji) began as pictures. Looking at their shapes can give you clues to their meanings.
messages.game.6428436302a8ccb9: When they conveyed the name of the arrived 「着」luggage with pictures... it got through!
messages.game.0189488d5e35dc72: That person said this: "Where the ship arrived, a tall figure was waiting"
messages.game.e8354d55be4d0b46: I looked up until my neck hurt. ...Just its palm is bigger than me.
messages.game.9bc4abc830fad671: The characters on the copying sheet are going wild, so the copying isn't getting done.
messages.game.45776d3cc904746a: To 「写」copy is to leave things just as they are. Straighten your 「身」posture and 「始」begin from the start.
messages.game.a30e87fd94b3317f: The monk's brush began to move in one smooth stroke.
messages.game.c72d85d7d21e4d81: He said this: "When you write one character at a time, the characters start to look like living creatures"
messages.game.32d2d88383e56344: An empty field. ...Or at least, it should be.
messages.game.a1583738965ba3ed: Mana is crouching down, staring fixedly at the soil. ...I've never seen her make a face like that.
messages.game.dd9b60a5c41e614c: Characters from a thousand years ago were dug up from this spot.
messages.game.b2f90e4c89320530: Someone wrote them, and someone read them. ...That's why they still remain today.
messages.game.0a3c45ed24232b01: ...That hill. I thought I glimpsed a single straw hat.
messages.game.58992337f668bda6: There's a sweet smell. ...The trees are full of orange fruit.
messages.game.2f59ce8ea770ba44: They can't read where the delivery routes go, so the mandarins are piling up.
messages.game.f61af0f350f033db: Where the 「農」farming families 「配」deliver to. 「路」means road.
messages.game.8b0c918b8f9a64db: Once the roads were clear, all the mandarins got carried off.
messages.game.4c74f26934a5131d: The old woman said this: "Toward where the character for 「山」mountain was rampaging, that person climbed up"
messages.game.2198bf8f05b8ac9e: The sea is spinning round and round. ...I've never seen anything like it.
messages.game.07e0087b84facbc5: No one can move because they can't read the times when crossing is safe.
messages.game.980d9eb2b971bce9: If you 「調」check, you can learn when the tide 「急」rushes fast. And when it 「終」ends, too.
messages.game.a5ee731c1290716c: The tide has gone quiet. We can cross now!
messages.game.d881cdc102b1fe3a: "These characters are still alive." ...That's what it sounded like.
messages.game.ae9561eca736d8b7: The children all ran away at once. ...That person didn't chase them. They just stood there.
messages.game.147c87365a4c0958: After that, the characters in this town began to run wild.
messages.game.22b809a5be0ec0ea: The udon shop owner said this: "Where that person came, the children were frightened. After that, the characters ran wild"
messages.game.12b0b01f2f6e6484: How far does this bridge go? ...From island to island, on and on.
messages.game.04f4e3555e729195: A patient suddenly fell ill, but they can't read where the clinic is.
messages.game.b7ba97870054eef0: 「医」is a person who heals injuries and illness. 「院」is a large building.
messages.game.5d92aedc499d5ab9: The clinic was across the bridge. ...Just in time!
messages.game.f7eeb69ee851b28a: The doctor said this: "Being able to read characters can sometimes save a life"
messages.game.4312a285e25b2cbb: White smoke rises here and there. ...Are they all hot spring baths?
messages.game.ce02bd34baa1c4f5: They can't read the inn names, so they don't know where to stay.
messages.game.aec801326a7cd624: The 「宿」inn's name. A 「定」fixed room. After 「談」talking with the innkeeper, it was settled without a hitch.
messages.game.6f0524b370422b1e: Beyond the steam, everyone is smiling.
messages.game.cc3996c52c1a56c1: The innkeeper said this: "I don't know their name. They're someone who arrives first and moves on first"
messages.game.af783d3451cb2051: The color of the water is completely different from before. ...A deep blue.
messages.game.b67e64979294856a: People are lining up at the dock. ...That back is there too.
messages.game.0ec24e87ca8ef3ee: ...We passed each other. From under the straw hat, our eyes met.
messages.game.6d256887acfaedfc: ...They were blue eyes. Maybe a person who came from a distant land.
messages.game.f886404fb807ec00: They said nothing. They just went on their way.
messages.game.ef9ef1bff6341461: It's hot! ...Even the shapes of the trees look like a southern land.
messages.game.8c1409c6f4ad41e4: ...The last town of Kansai and Shikoku.
messages.game.8b2820e173fb47d4: My stomach is growling. …It smells like broth.
messages.game.b544ddc67c6bcb8b: …Oh. The kids are crowding around the big figure.
